findings.evidence: The shown prompt (interview/ny/2025/questions.yaml:126-129) is 'from the federal government, the military, or a New York State or local government job'; the p. 9 list includes 'its territories, possessions... or the District of Columbia' and the only wording that names them is the internal form label the filer does not see. The follow-up ny_it201.ask.gov_pension_other names only the MTA, MABSTOA, LIRR and SUNY, CUNY and State Education plans.
ny_it201.ask.gov_pension_other asks 'Was any of it from the MTA, MABSTOA, the Long Island Rail Road...' after a No (gate ny_it201.gov_said_no), covering the three authorities of p. 9.
The same follow-up names 'a SUNY, CUNY or State Education Department plan (such as TIAA)', covering the Optional Retirement Program of ny_it201i p. 9.

The question asks about 'pension or retirement money' (any of it); ny_it201.gov_pension_candidate reads line 9 or 10 or a disability pension in wages, and the help counts 'a refund of your own contributions' (ny_it201i p. 9, 'return of contributions in a year prior to retirement').
